library(ordinal)
library(MASS)
library(rms)

set.seed(42)
options <- c("agrumpy", "bneutral", "chappy")
unweighted <- c(3, 1, 1)
weighted_happy <- c(3, 1, 1)
weighted_unhappy <- c(3, 1, 1)
big <- sample(options, size = 1000, replace = TRUE, prob = unweighted)
med <- sample(options, size = 1000, replace = TRUE, prob = weighted_happy)
small <- sample(options, size = 1000, replace = TRUE, prob = weighted_unhappy)
big_df <- data.frame(class = "big", scores = big)
med_df <- data.frame(class = "med", scores = med)
small_df <- data.frame(class = "small", scores = small)
size_df <- rbind(big_df, med_df, small_df)
size_df$"scores" <- as.ordered(size_df$"scores")
modelnull <- ordinal::clm(scores ~ 1, data = size_df, link = "logit")
model1 <- ordinal::clm(scores ~ class, data = size_df, link = "logit")
anova(modelnull, model1)
m1 <- polr(scores ~ class, data = size_df)
m2 <- polr(scores ~ 1, data = size_df)
anova(m2, m1)
orm(scores ~ class, data = size_df)


olr_model <- MASS::polr(scores ~ class, size_df, Hess = TRUE)
ctable <- stats::coef(summary(olr_model))
p <- stats::pnorm(abs(ctable[, "t value"]), lower.tail = FALSE) * 2
ctable <- cbind(ctable, "p value" = p)
ctable


ord_reg_p <- function(clust_membership, outcome_df, outcome_var) {
    merged_df <-
        dplyr::inner_join(clust_membership, outcome_df, by = "subjectkey")
    merged_df$"cluster" <- as.factor(merged_df$"cluster")
    merged_df[, outcome_var] <- as.ordered(merged_df[, outcome_var])
    olr_model <- MASS::polr(
        merged_df[, outcome_var] ~ merged_df[, "cluster"],
        Hess = TRUE)
    ctable <- stats::coef(summary(olr_model))
    p <- stats::pnorm(abs(ctable[, "t value"]), lower.tail = FALSE) * 2
    ctable <- cbind(ctable, "p value" = p)
    p_df <- data.frame(names = row.names(ctable), ctable) |>
        dplyr::filter(grepl("cluster", row.names(ctable), fixed = TRUE))
    p_val <- min(p_df$"p.value")
    return(p_val)
}

# Spits out overall p value

    dplyr::inner_join(clust_membership, outcome_df, by = "subjectkey")
merged_df$"cluster" <- as.factor(merged_df$"cluster")
model <- lm(merged_df[, "sleep_total_problems"] ~ merged_df[, "cluster"])
fstat <- summary(model)$"fstatistic"
p <- pf(fstat[1], fstat[2], fstat[3], lower.tail = FALSE)
attributes(p) <- NULL
print(p)
